annotations.title: Is a hearing loss OSHA recordable (Standard Threshold Shift)?

description: Compare a baseline and current audiogram at 2000, 3000 and 4000 Hz under 29 CFR 1904.10: Standard Threshold Shift of 10 dB average plus a 25 dB hearing level in the same ear. Optional age correction from 29 CFR 1910.95 Appendix F.

ageCorrectSex.description: Apply Appendix F age correction using the male or female table
